neighbours.label: the token closing a Python %-format placeholder inside a string: the 's' of '%s', or the key of '%(key)s'
fire:
sql = 'name = "%s" AND owner = "%s"' % (name, owner)
flag = 'HOME="%s" ' % home

env = 'PATH="%s" LANG="%s"' % (path, lang)
call(env)
note = 'NODE="%s" ' % node

shell = "cd %s ; rm -rf %s ; mkdir %s" % (root, tmp, tmp)
run(shell)

logger.warning('Failed to save invoice for [%s] to DB. Status was [%s]' % (order, status))
logger.warning('Failed to send mail for [%s]' % order)

file_name = "%s_%s_%s.tar" % (app, version, arch)
cmd = "cp %s %s/%s" % (file_name, out, file_name)

msg = 'user "%s" in group "%s"' % (user, group)
print(msg)
msg = 'role "%s"' % role
quiet:
sql = 'name = "' + name + '" AND owner = "' + owner + '"'
flag = 'HOME="' + home + '" '

env = f'PATH="{path}" LANG="{lang}"'
call(env)
note = f'NODE="{node}" '

shell = "cd {} ; rm -rf {} ; mkdir {}".format(root, tmp, tmp)
run(shell)

logger.warning('Failed to save invoice for [{}] to DB. Status was [{}]'.format(order, status))
logger.warning('Failed to send mail for [{}]'.format(order))

file_name = "_".join([app, version, arch])
cmd = " ".join(["cp", file_name, out])

url = 'host = ' + host + ' AND port = ' + port
search(url)

msg = 'user ' + user + ' in group ' + group
print(msg)
msg = 'role ' + role

notes: Readings varied in probing: ' ="%s"' reached 1.0, 'cd %s' 0.22, while '[%s]' peaked below 0.1 in one short snippet even though it tops the card. Fire items are multi-line code.
